law_name: Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Protection Act, 1994 (Act No. 6 of 1994), as amended by the Business and Intellectual Property Authority Act 8 of 2016 (in force 16 Jan 2017; commenced 15 Mar 1996)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (s. 6; Commons summary; state works 50 years from publication, s. 6(5); sound recordings 50 years)
registration_required: No (voluntary electronic copyright registration system launched 2026; unconfirmed)
notes: Berne: Paris Act accession 1993 (WIPO notice). TRIPS per IFLA 2012. WCT/WPPT: signed 1996 only per IFLA 2012, accession not confirmed. Replacement Copyright and Related Rights Bill drafted, not yet tabled as of Feb 2026 (parliament.na). NASCAM is the music collecting society.
